laws.rule: Parts of Taplejung (Kanchenjunga area: Phantanglung, Mikwakhola, Sirijunga) and Sankhuwasabha (Makalu area) need a restricted area permit of USD 20 a person a week for the first four weeks, then USD 25 a week. Restricted areas are closed to free individual trekkers: the Department of Immigration issues the permit only through a licensed agency, for a group, and not beyond your visa's expiry. Fees are quoted in US dollars and paid in Nepali rupees.
